prompt: The numbers of text messages six friends sent during lunch were $4, 9, 12, 15, 20, 26$. What is the median?
hint: The list is already in order. With an EVEN number of values there are two middle numbers.

hints.text: The list is already in order. With an EVEN number of values there are two middle numbers.
The two middle values are the 3rd and 4th: $12$ and $15$. Average them.

alternativeExplanations.title: Cross off from both ends
steps: Cross off 4 and 26. Cross off 9 and 20.
Two numbers remain, 12 and 15; halfway between them is 13.5.
